MappingPage                          baseline 03f2168, before tldraw
|-- MappingPocPage({ services })
|   `-- MappingServicesContext -> MappingWorkspacePage
|       |-- diagrams: DiagramService [G]
|       |-- canvasHistory: CanvasHistoryService [E]
|       `-- workspaceStorage ?? new WorkspaceStorage
|-- CanvasWorkspace: registry + session lifetimes
|   |-- drafts: Record<documentId, CanvasDraft>
|   |   |-- metadata: name, representationId?, revisionId
|   |   |-- baseline: savedName, savedScene, savedEdges?
|   |   |-- hidden?, busy, newerRevision?, reloadKey?
|   |   |-- viewport?, focusBox?
|   |   `-- session: CanvasSession
|   |       |-- controller: MappingDocumentController [D]
|   |       |   |-- document: MappingGridDocument
|   |       |   |   |-- scene: LineGridScene [A]
|   |       |   |   |   |-- root: GridBox
|   |       |   |   |   `-- contents: Record<id, Diagram> [B]
|   |       |   |   |-- edges: DiagramConnection[]
|   |       |   |   |-- jumps?: CanvasJump[]
|   |       |   |   `-- sections: Record<contentId, sections[]>
|   |       |   |-- canvas: MappingCanvasState
|   |       |   |   |-- selection: SelectionState
|   |       |   |   |   `-- items: whole diagram OR captured region
|   |       |   |   |-- diagramViews?: per-instance subtree folds
|   |       |   |   |-- display: DisplayState [C]
|   |       |   |   |   |-- rootIds: floating ownership roots
|   |       |   |   |   `-- nodes: Record<id, FloatingPane>
|   |       |   |   `-- controls: MappingControls
|   |       |   |       |-- activeBoxId, selectionFocusId, activeThreadId
|   |       |   |       `-- surfaces: actions / prompt / ask / status
|   |       |   `-- contextId, canvasRevisionId, version, canUndo/Redo
|   |       `-- read-only stores publish controller references
|   |           |-- document -> search / explorer
|   |           |-- presentation -> display + diagramViews
|   |           |-- selection / controls / geometry
|   |           `-- status -> dirty baseline + undo/redo
|   |-- controllers: Map<documentId, MappingDocumentController>
|   |-- changes.version / dirtyScenes.ids
|   `-- onCommit -> changed() + onPersist([documentId])
|-- CanvasDisplayNode: derived registry over existing owners
|   |-- grid:<boxId> -> diagram | group; geometry in cells
|   |-- floating:<id> -> FloatingPane; geometry in pixels
|   |-- floating arrows -> drawEdge(document.edges)
|   `-- childIds, expansion, collapsible subtrees; cloned read result
|-- SourcePaneViewState: live scroll + camera owner
|   |-- bind(documentId, paneId, sourceFile, sourceId?)
|   |-- setCamera(documentId, CanvasTransform)
|   |-- captureDisplay / captureCamera at save or copy
|   `-- coalesced notifications -> persistence; flush / prune / dispose
|-- Mounted document views
|   |-- SourcePaneDocumentContext + active context
|   |-- DraggableDiagramCanvas: transform + focus
|   |   `-- MappingPocSelectionCanvas(session)
|   |       |-- update diagram -> DiagramEditCoordinator
|   |       |-- transfer / undo / jump callbacks
|   |       `-- project context, projection catalog, search matches
|   `-- visited documents stay mounted; inactive/hidden views hidden
|-- Page coordination
|   |-- activeId + project catalog + draft aliases
|   |-- open saved revision -> documentFromRevision + historyFromRevision
|   |-- save project -> captured scene / edges / history / name
|   |   `-- acknowledgement updates captured baseline
|   |-- copyDocument -> forkHistory; clear selection + controls
|   |-- transfer copy/move -> capture / prepare / persist / install [E]
|   |-- undo/redo -> local controller OR workspace transfer boundary
|   `-- restore / import / export: MappingWorkspaceSnapshot v3
|-- Search and editing surfaces
|   |-- DiagramSearchService -> saved + draft + proposal documents
|   |-- reveal result -> check content revision + ASCII hash
|   |-- MappingDiagramExplorer -> open / focus / delete / transfer
|   |-- ChangeSessionPreview -> proposal / accepted canvases
|   `-- DiagramEditComposer + DiagramEditCoordinator
|-- Agent access [D]
|   |-- useAgentCanvasBridge -> handleAgentCommand
|   |-- read context / document-state / snapshot
|   `-- apply operations / apply revision / copy / create
`-- Workspace persistence
    |-- WorkspacePersistence(workspace, records, projectId, viewState)
    |   |-- onPersist + view notifications -> record changes
    |   |-- metadata / baseline / canvas / viewport
    |   |-- controller.persistenceChanges(cursor) -> history records
    |   `-- workspace index: documentIds, activeDocumentId, transfers
    |-- RecordStorage: cache + pending changes + one in-flight batch
    |   `-- requestId + expectedRevision -> transport.write(batch)
    |-- WorkspaceStorage: one worker per opened workspace
    |   `-- /api/mapping/workspace/records
    `-- explicit transfer: storage.save() ACK -> installWorkspace()
